text:
Alisa: quick sync: proposal — sessionized sampling for request/response logs so redaction rules and sampling are applied at the session level (respect per-session consent + deterministic scrub). thoughts?

Matt: ++ makes sense for chatty routes. how do we handle idempotent requests? if same request_id comes back later we should get same scrub decision right?

Alisa: yes. idea: sampling_key = sha256(session_id || tenant_id || global_salt) % 10000. store sample_decision on session and persist request_id -> sample_id for 24h so retries get same outcome. sketch:```yaml
sampling:
  key: "sha256(session_id|tenant|salt) % 10000"
  buckets: 0..9999
  retention: session_ttl (24h)
  request_cache_ttl: 24h
```

Matt: sg. Concern: per-request cache in Redis could spike. maybe only store request_id when request_id is present and fall back to session mapping otherwise. TTLs should be short.

Claudia: on PII: we need deterministic pseudonymization so the same name maps to same pseudonym within a session but not globally. That avoids cross-session linkage. we'll need per-session pseudonym map with TTL + encrypted storage.

Jamal: legal note: if user revokes consent mid-session we must stop capturing and kick off deletions. retroactive deletion of derived pseudonyms is tricky — we need a deletion job that removes ephemeral maps and any stored raw snippets. how do we guarantee deletion across caches + replicas?

Alisa: plan: consent flag lives in session meta. revoke -> set session.no_audit = true -> enqueue deletion job (best-effort) that walks pseudonym keys, request caches, and sampled payloads. we only persist minimal provenance: sample_id, session_hash, reason, and deletion-ops logs (no raw payload). docs/RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/session-sampling

Matt: UX ask: console needs a new view: "Sampled sessions" (filterable by route/tenant/reason) + action column: Revoke sampling (triggers deletion), Mark as persistent (ops), and View provenance. Each action should show expected side-effects.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy: sampling-service v2 started on prod/us-west1 (rev: 2026.03.18-pts).

Claudia: edge case: embeddings/repayload routes — never store raw embedding inputs. For embeddings we should only store salted hashes and a pointer to sample_id. sampling decision for embeddings must respect embedding_retention policy (likely stricter).

Jamal: +1. For audit we only keep minimal rows: {sample_id, session_id_hash, decision_reason, created_at, deleted_at(if any)}. No raw request/response bodies.

Matt: performance question: do we want prefix caching of per-session pseudonym maps (LRU) to speed redaction at runtime? we can store encrypted values in cache and decrypt via KMS on hit.

Alisa: yes encryption mandatory. pseudonym store encrypted, TTL aligned with session TTL. also need metrics: sample_rate_by_route, revoke_count, deletion_failures_count.

Matt: I'll take the sampling-service PR (schema + request-cache behavior).

Claudia: I'll own pseudonym store spec and deletion workflow (will add encryption + backup/rotate notes).

Jamal: I'll draft the consent-revocation legal text and retention limits; will ping privacy counsel.

Alisa: :thumbsup: thanks all. can we sync Thu 10am to align console mockups + infra changes? @Matt @Claudia @Jamal

Matt: works for me.

Claudia: yep.

Jamal: +1
